2608.26074.title: Gating Before Commitment: Anticipating Intent Divergence to Prevent Post-Interaction Decision Failures in Autonomous Driving
2608.26074.paper_summary: Intent misinterpretation during vehicle interactions causes recurring planning failures. We study a decision layer in which a language-guided intent module reads structured descriptors, computes a smoothed intent-geometry divergence score, and gates the planned maneuver before commitment, upstream of a corridor envelope. On a replayed off-road departure and four crash clips under a frozen, disclosed implementation, gating is the only layer that repairs the plan: on the main case it fires 72 ms after the drift onset but 161 ms before the corridor exit, keeping the trajectory in the corridor in all ten replays. The first calibration draws nine false triggers in 5.9 minutes, each from scoring uncertainty as half a conflict; a preregistered redesign treating uncertainty as abstention cuts this to 0.341 per minute. Two ablations bound the model's contribution: the full score detects fastest on four of five failures under the deployed eligibility, three of five against the unvetoed rule (000871 by one cycle; 000228 by a pre-onset fire on an uncertain stretch that five clips cannot classify as signal or coincidence; dropping the confidence term costs two detections), while on in-domain tracks at equal false positives the geometric rule more than triples its detection. The evidence supports the gating mechanism; the model's demonstrated roles are the fastest detection on these failures and an uncertainty veto on the geometric rule.
2608.26074.paper_summary_zh: 意圖誤解在車輛互動中導致重複的規劃失敗。<lb/>我們研究一個決策層，其中一個語言引導的意圖模塊讀取結構化描述符，計算平滑的意圖幾何偏差分數，並在承諾之前對計劃的操控進行閘控，位於走廊包絡線的上游。<lb/>在重播的越野出發和四個事故片段下，使用凍結的公開實現，閘控是唯一修復計劃的層：在主要案例中，它在漂移開始後72毫秒觸發，但在走廊出口前161毫秒觸發，保持所有十次重播中的軌跡在走廊內。<lb/>第一次校準在5.9分鐘內引發九次錯誤觸發，每次都是因為將不確定性評分為半個衝突；一個預註冊的重新設計將不確定性視為棄權，將此數字減少到每分鐘0.341。<lb/>兩次消融實驗界定了模型的貢獻：完整的分數在部署的合格條件下能在五次失敗中最快檢測到四次，在未被否決的規則下檢測到五次中的三次（000871因一個循環；000228因在一段不確定的區域上提前觸發，該區域五個片段無法分類為信號或巧合；去掉信心項會損失兩次檢測），而在同域軌道上以相同的假陽性率，幾何規則的檢測率超過三倍。<lb/>證據支持閘控機制；模型展示的角色是對這些失敗的最快檢測和對幾何規則的不確定性否決。
